streeter.text: I just knew I nailed it. The difference between being "ok" and "nailing it" was directly attributable to the work we've done together. Thank you!
streeter.name: Stephanie Streeter

beck.text: It's amazing the effect you have on people. Everybody on my staff comes away with gratitude and respect.
beck.name: Alan Beck

alvidrez.text: When your on-air people lobby for a chance to see the talent coach, you know something must be working!
alvidrez.name: Phil Alvidrez

rosenheim.text: Whether she's working with one of our main anchors or a newspaper reporter just learning to be on TV, Judy has a rare ability to support people's strengths and help them overcome any weaknesses.
rosenheim.name: Dan Rosenheim

phillips.text: I should have done this years ago. What an important class for learning to speak effectively. Whether you are new to the subject or a seasoned lecturer, Speaking for Impact will bring your speaking to the next level.
phillips.name: Heather Phillips

kegley.text: When I saw your curriculum, your style and your approach in action with Aflac's senior team, I was amazed. I believe this is a program everyone would benefit from.
kegley.name: Diane Kegley

donohue.text: There was not a minute in the day that I did not find valuable.
donohue.name: Kate Donohue

hannan.text: Immersive and sometimes confronting, the course gets right to your strengths and weaknesses and helps you improve where necessary.
hannan.name: Scott Hannan

levy.text: I feel so much more confident and in control.
levy.name: Nikki Levy

philippi.text: Helped me raise my game and reach my career potential.
philippi.name: Dale Philippi
philippi.role: VP and GM, Price Pfister, Black and Decker

kenney.text: Speaking for Impact improved my ability to leverage my strengths and learn new techniques.
kenney.name: Karen Kenney
kenney.role: Executive Director, Girls Inc. of the Island City

nubla.text: Thank you for all the help and support you gave me early in my career. I was so lucky to work with you Judy and will be forever thankful.
nubla.name: Christine Nubla

pomerantz.text: Presentation training is critical to your success in your professional and personal life in terms of how you position yourself. We all have our gifts and this is about getting the practical steps to hone in on your strengths.
pomerantz.name: Carrie Schwab Pomerantz

jaggar.text: I was able to deliver in a more conversational, engaging style than I sometimes have in formal presentations. … Not one person left during the talk and they almost all stayed for another hour asking questions.
jaggar.name: Karuna Jaggar
jaggar.role: Executive Director, East Bay Women's Initiative for Self Employment

correia.text: The board of directors meeting went great! They approved the package unanimously! I believe your expertise and coaching made the difference.
correia.name: Kathryn Correia

takayama.text: I received rave reviews about my performance this morning. My energy level and connection were much stronger. I attribute all of this to your coaching, advice and helping me take advantage of my natural strengths.
takayama.name: Ellen Takayama

maulsby.text: Judy and I worked together to prepare me for a number of media interviews. … In reality, I was OK, but Judy made me far better. When I think of all the consultants I have hired … by far, Judy is among the very best values.
maulsby.name: Bill Maulsby

finserv.text: The client decided to transfer $25 million right after our luncheon meeting! The presentation, the practice, the pitch all led to this positive action because of our engaged work together.
finserv.name: Sr. VP

oloughlin.text: What you do so well is engaging me at my pace so I can break through. Your warm style makes this really fun!
oloughlin.name: Sheryl O'Loughlin
